label: Spindle motor overcurrent
probable_cause: Mechanical binding or a dull cutting tool drawing excess current
operator_action: Stop the cycle and inspect the spindle and tool for obstruction before restarting

label: Spindle motor overtemperature
probable_cause: Prolonged heavy-duty cycle or blocked cooling airflow
operator_action: Let the spindle cool down and clear the cooling vents

label: Servo drive following error
probable_cause: Axis cannot keep up with the commanded motion because of load or an obstruction
operator_action: Clear any obstruction on the axis and re-home the machine

label: Servo drive bus undervoltage
probable_cause: Mains supply dip or a loose power connection at the drive
operator_action: Check the incoming supply and the drive power wiring

label: Servo drive bus overvoltage
probable_cause: Regeneration during rapid deceleration with a faulty braking resistor
operator_action: Inspect the braking resistor and its wiring

label: Motor encoder signal lost
probable_cause: Damaged encoder cable or connector on the motor
operator_action: Reseat or replace the motor encoder cable

label: Axis motion timeout
probable_cause: The move did not complete within the expected time
operator_action: Check for mechanical drag and verify the axis is free to move

label: Holding brake not releasing
probable_cause: Brake power supply fault or a worn holding brake
operator_action: Do not force the axis; call maintenance to check the holding brake

label: Spindle fails to reach target speed
probable_cause: Worn drive belt or a failing spindle bearing
operator_action: Inspect the spindle drive belt and bearings

label: Drive cooling fan failure
probable_cause: Fan clogged with dust or at the end of its life
operator_action: Replace the drive cooling fan

label: Part-present sensor no signal
probable_cause: Missing part or a misaligned photoelectric sensor
operator_action: Confirm a part is loaded and realign the sensor

label: Clamp-closed sensor not detected
probable_cause: Clamp not fully closed or a faulty proximity switch
operator_action: Check the clamp movement and the proximity switch gap

label: Tool-length probe no touch
probable_cause: Probe stylus damaged or contaminated
operator_action: Clean or replace the tool-length probe stylus

label: Vibration sensor over range
probable_cause: Excessive process vibration or a loose sensor mount
operator_action: Stop and inspect the tool and workholding for looseness

label: Temperature sensor open circuit
probable_cause: Broken thermocouple or a disconnected sensor lead
operator_action: Reconnect or replace the temperature sensor

label: Temperature sensor short circuit
probable_cause: Pinched or chafed sensor wiring
operator_action: Inspect and repair the temperature sensor wiring

label: Pressure transducer out of range
probable_cause: Failed transducer or a blocked sensing port
operator_action: Verify the real pressure with a gauge and replace the transducer if needed

label: Linear scale read error
probable_cause: Contamination on the glass scale or the read head
operator_action: Clean the linear scale and the read head

label: Proximity sensor always on
probable_cause: Metal debris on the sensor face or a wiring short
operator_action: Clean the sensor face and check its wiring

label: Light curtain lens contamination
probable_cause: Dust or an oil film on the light curtain optics
operator_action: Clean the light curtain lenses at the next stop

label: Supply air pressure low
probable_cause: Compressed air supply below setpoint or a leak upstream
operator_action: Check the shop air supply and the inlet regulator

label: Supply air pressure lost
probable_cause: Main air valve closed or a major line rupture
operator_action: Stop work and restore the compressed air supply

label: Clamp cylinder fails to extend
probable_cause: Blocked flow control or a failed solenoid valve
operator_action: Check the clamp solenoid valve and the flow controls

label: Clamp cylinder fails to retract
probable_cause: Seized cylinder or an exhaust restriction
operator_action: Inspect the clamp cylinder and its exhaust muffler

label: Air dryer dew point high
probable_cause: Saturated desiccant or an air dryer fault
operator_action: Have the air dryer serviced

label: Excessive air consumption detected
probable_cause: Significant pneumatic leak in the tooling
operator_action: Perform a leak check on the tool air lines

label: Vacuum level insufficient
probable_cause: Clogged vacuum filter or a leak at the suction cups
operator_action: Replace the vacuum filter and check the suction cups

label: Lubricator oil level low
probable_cause: Air-line lubricator reservoir near empty
operator_action: Refill the air-line lubricator with the specified oil

label: Water in air filter bowl
probable_cause: Auto-drain failed on the filter regulator
operator_action: Manually drain the filter bowl and check the auto-drain

label: Pneumatic valve response slow
probable_cause: Contaminated valve or low ambient temperature
operator_action: Cycle the valve a few times and check the air quality

label: Emergency stop active
probable_cause: An emergency stop button has been pressed
operator_action: Find out why the E-stop was pressed, make the area safe, then reset and re-arm

label: Safety gate open
probable_cause: A guard door was opened during automatic mode
operator_action: Close the safety gate and acknowledge the fault before restarting

label: Light curtain interrupted
probable_cause: An object or a person broke the light curtain beam
operator_action: Clear the protected area and reset the light curtain

label: Safety controller fault
probable_cause: Internal diagnostic fault in the safety PLC
operator_action: Do not bypass; call maintenance to inspect the safety controller

label: Dual-channel input mismatch
probable_cause: One channel of a safety device has failed or is miswired
operator_action: Report to maintenance; a safety input needs inspection

label: Safety relay welded contact
probable_cause: Output contact stuck closed at the end of its life
operator_action: Take the cell out of service and replace the safety relay

label: Muting sensor fault
probable_cause: Muting sensors out of sequence or blocked
operator_action: Clear the muting sensors and check their alignment

label: Enabling device released
probable_cause: The three-position enable switch was let go during teach mode
operator_action: Hold the enabling device correctly to continue jogging

label: Area scanner zone violation
probable_cause: Someone entered the protected floor zone
operator_action: Clear the scanner zone and reset

label: Safe torque off requested
probable_cause: The STO input was dropped by a safety device
operator_action: Resolve the triggering safety device, then reset STO

label: Fieldbus node offline
probable_cause: An EtherCAT or PROFINET device is not responding
operator_action: Check the network cabling and the power to the affected node

label: Fieldbus frame errors high
probable_cause: Damaged network cable or electrical noise on the line
operator_action: Inspect the fieldbus cable and reroute it away from power lines

label: PLC heartbeat lost
probable_cause: The cell PLC is not updating the watchdog signal
operator_action: Check the PLC status and the link to the robot controller

label: MES connection lost
probable_cause: Plant network or MES server unavailable
operator_action: Notify IT; run in local mode only if permitted

label: Barcode scanner no response
probable_cause: Scanner unplugged or its firmware has hung
operator_action: Power-cycle the barcode scanner

label: Robot-to-cell handshake timeout
probable_cause: The signal exchange was not completed in time
operator_action: Check the interlock signals between the robot and the cell

label: IO-Link device error
probable_cause: A smart sensor is reporting a device-level fault
operator_action: Read the IO-Link device diagnostics and replace the sensor if faulty

label: Time synchronization lost
probable_cause: The NTP time source is unreachable
operator_action: Restore the connection to the time server

label: Duplicate IP address detected
probable_cause: Two devices are configured with the same address
operator_action: Correct the network configuration of the newly added device

label: OPC UA subscription dropped
probable_cause: The client or server connection was reset
operator_action: Reconnect the OPC UA client

label: Drill bit broken
probable_cause: Tool breakage detected by spindle load or the tool probe
operator_action: Remove the broken drill bit, inspect the hole, and load a new tool

label: Drill bit worn beyond limit
probable_cause: The tool life counter has reached its limit
operator_action: Replace the drill bit and reset the tool life counter

label: Wrong tool loaded
probable_cause: The tool ID does not match the program requirement
operator_action: Load the tool called for by the program

label: Tool not clamped in spindle
probable_cause: Drawbar not fully engaged or a dirty spindle taper
operator_action: Clean the tool taper and verify that the drawbar clamps fully

label: Rivet feed jam
probable_cause: A rivet is stuck in the feed track
operator_action: Clear the jammed rivet from the feed system

label: Rivet upset force out of tolerance
probable_cause: Worn anvil or an incorrect rivet size
operator_action: Check the anvil condition and confirm the rivet size

label: Collet worn
probable_cause: The collet no longer grips the tool within specification
operator_action: Replace the collet

label: Tool magazine position fault
probable_cause: The magazine is not indexed to the correct pocket
operator_action: Re-index the tool magazine and check the position sensor

label: Coolant flow to tool low
probable_cause: Clogged coolant nozzle or a low coolant level
operator_action: Clear the coolant nozzle and top up the coolant

label: Countersink depth out of tolerance
probable_cause: Tool wear or an incorrect tool offset
operator_action: Re-measure the countersink and update the tool offset

label: Robot mastering lost
probable_cause: Encoder reference lost after a power loss or a collision
operator_action: Perform the robot mastering procedure before returning to production

label: TCP calibration out of date
probable_cause: The tool center point was not verified within the required interval
operator_action: Run the TCP calibration routine

label: Vision system not calibrated
probable_cause: Camera-to-robot calibration is missing or has expired
operator_action: Perform the hand-eye calibration

label: Force sensor drift
probable_cause: The load cell zero has drifted beyond tolerance
operator_action: Re-zero the force sensor with no load applied

label: Axis home position mismatch
probable_cause: Home switch has shifted or the belt skipped a tooth
operator_action: Re-home the machine and verify it against the reference pin

label: Probe calibration failed
probable_cause: Dirty reference sphere or a damaged probe
operator_action: Clean the reference sphere and repeat the probe calibration

label: Laser tracker verification overdue
probable_cause: The volumetric accuracy check is past its due date
operator_action: Schedule the laser tracker verification

label: Temperature compensation disabled
probable_cause: The thermal model is turned off or a sensor is missing
operator_action: Enable temperature compensation and confirm the sensor readings

label: Fixture offset not set
probable_cause: The work coordinate origin has not been taught for this fixture
operator_action: Teach the fixture offset before running the program

label: Grid plate check failed
probable_cause: The measured grid deviates from nominal
operator_action: Report the result to metrology; do not run precision features

label: Program not found
probable_cause: The requested part program is missing from the controller
operator_action: Load the correct part program

label: Program checksum mismatch
probable_cause: Program file corrupted or edited outside of version control
operator_action: Reload the released version of the program

label: Controller battery low
probable_cause: The real-time clock or memory backup battery is near the end of its life
operator_action: Schedule replacement of the controller backup battery

label: Controller memory full
probable_cause: Log files or old programs are filling the storage
operator_action: Archive and clear old files from the controller

label: Axis soft limit reached
probable_cause: The programmed move exceeds the software travel limit
operator_action: Check the program offsets and jog the axis back into range

label: Cycle aborted by operator
probable_cause: Feed hold or reset was pressed during the cycle
operator_action: Return the machine to a safe start point and restart the cycle

label: Power supply 24V out of range
probable_cause: Overloaded or failing 24 V power supply
operator_action: Check the 24 V load and the power supply output

label: Cabinet temperature high
probable_cause: Cabinet cooling unit fault or a blocked filter
operator_action: Clean or service the control cabinet cooling unit

label: UPS on battery
probable_cause: Incoming mains power has been lost
operator_action: Save the machine state and prepare for a controlled shutdown

label: Firmware version mismatch
probable_cause: Module firmware does not match the project configuration
operator_action: Update the module firmware to the released version
